summary: Right mid/upper lung, densely opacified on prior, is now more aerated on current, while a new curved meniscus-shaped opacity has appeared at the right lower zone/costophrenic region.

findings.rationale: The right mid-to-upper lung, which was densely and diffusely opacified on the prior, now shows visible vascular markings and improved aeration on current.
A discrete curved (meniscus-shaped) opacity is now present at the right costophrenic region on current, not clearly present as a distinct meniscus on the prior which was diffusely consolidated.
